The '''Vanjervalis system''' was located in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of the [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]].<ref name="TEA" /> It shared its name with the [[Computer/Legends|computer]] conglomerate [[Vanjervalis Systems]]<ref name="KOTORCG">''[[Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide]]''</ref> as well as the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] manufacturer [[Rendili/Vanjervalis Drive Yards]], the latter of which was based at<ref name="KOTORHB">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic Handbook]]''</ref> the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="TEA" /> [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]].<ref name="KOTORHB" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Vanjervalis system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square N-11.<ref name="TEA" />
